name: ZizkaDB
description: Tamper-evident, causal audit trail of what your agent did and why: messages, tool calls, model outputs and token usage, linked cause to effect. Observe-only: never blocks or changes a message or tool call.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: ZizkaDB Cloud key from db.zizka.ai → Settings. Leave empty for a self-hosted server, or set ZIZKADB_API_KEY.

host.label: Self-hosted URL
host.help: Your own ZizkaDB server. Leave empty for ZizkaDB Cloud. Or set ZIZKADB_HOST.

agent.label: Agent name
agent.help: Name this gateway's events are recorded under in ZizkaDB.

captureContent.label: Record content
captureContent.help: Off: record which tools and models ran, token usage and errors, but not prompts, replies, tool arguments or results.
